spec.title: The proof tier after example 290's second round of engine changes, VF-018's three tests apart: every other ignored Rust test in release, none hidden by a failure
spec.description: Runs the proof tier's command with cargo's --no-fail-fast and without the three heap tests VF-018 tracks (JBMC's timeouts, which no change here touches), as the jobs after examples 287 to 290 did. The change behind it is in the own checker (lib/src/bmc), which nearly every proof-tier test runs: Arrays.copyOf of an array of references is modelled where it was refused for its array result; new ConcurrentHashMap() and new ConcurrentHashMap(int) make an object with no content where each was a gap; a model of java.util.ArrayList is run only for a check that asks for it (--model), so the class is as it was for every test of the tier; a regression check made as a property of the pair of versions answers the previous version's Class.forName and getName on its own class path, and takes --observed-initializer and --model. The tests of what changed (the unit tests, claims, values, conformance, pairing, object_strings, loops, value_parameters) pass inline.
spec.expected: exits 0: every proof-tier test but VF-018's three passes

resources.notes: the same job after example 290's first round took about 35 minutes
